# IPO Watch (ipowatch.co)

> Indian public equity IPO and primary market intelligence from NSE and BSE.

IPO Watch is a clean, data-driven index for tracking Indian primary market issues (IPOs, SME IPOs, Buybacks, Offers for Sale, Rights Issues, REITs, and InvITs) since 2001. It focuses on factual timelines, pricing, subscription demand books, prospectus documents, and historical listing-day and current performance.

## Core Content Principles (AI-Friendly)
- **Scrape provenance**: All data matches official exchange (NSE/BSE) raw feeds, moneycontrol, capitalmarket, and trendlyne.
- **Structured Schemas**: Every dynamic issue page includes structured JSON-LD (`FinancialProduct`, `Event`, `BreadcrumbList`) with precise timing in Indian Standard Time (IST, +05:30).
- **Factual & Objective**: Focuses strictly on pricing, lot sizes, BRLMs, registrars, and returns. Contains zero grey-market speculation, broker links, or opinions.

## Main Navigation Map

- [Live IPOs](/live/): Indian IPOs currently open for subscription with live bid tracking and subscription multiples.
- [Upcoming Listings](/upcoming/): Confirmed future listings with announced price bands and lot sizes.
- [New Filings](/new-filings/): IPOs in draft stages (DRHP/RHP) awaiting exchange approval.
- [Performance Tracker](/performance/): Comprehensive listing-day and current absolute returns.
- [Bidding Demand](/demand/): Trajectory curves showing subscription multipliers by bidder category.
- [Annual Archive](/archive/): Chronological primary market list indexed by calendar year (2001 - present).
- [Academy & Glossary](/academy/): Reference guides on book-building, allotment mathematics, ASBA/UPI systems, and Indian financial regulations.
